title: The Ledger of Little Hawley
author: Petra Kavanagh
blurb: Ada Villalobos, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
